t8nde0.jls: CharLS JPEG-LS conformance test image (9421 bytes).
Source: https://github.com/team-charls/charls/blob/main/test/data/conformance/t8nde0.jls
Downloaded from the official team-charls repository for parser regression testing.
JPEG-LS marker detection reference:
https://github.com/team-charls/charls/blob/main/src/scan_decoder.hpp

openjpeg-3x2.j2k: Synthetic RGB codestream generated locally using the bundled
Pillow library and its OpenJPEG encoder. Three columns, two rows, color (10,20,30).
Generation: Image.new('RGB',(3,2),(10,20,30)).save(out,format='JPEG2000',no_jp2=True)
No third-party image content. The generator is not a dependency of the tests.
Encoder API: https://pillow.readthedocs.io/en/stable/handbook/image-file-formats.html#jpeg-2000
